# Synopsis: *The Fallen*
### Book One of the Earth Reborn Trilogy

**Author**: Raymond Bayly  
**Series**: *Earth Reborn Trilogy* (Book 1 of 3)  
**Genre**: Post-Apocalyptic Military Fantasy / Sci-Fi  
**Length**: ~151,800 words · Prologue + 16 Chapters  
**Formats Available**: PDF, DOCX, Markdown  

---

## Part I: Retail Back Cover Blurb

> *"The world did not die when the sky caught fire. It merely held its breath, waiting in the frozen dark until the stones themselves learned how to speak."*

***

extra.section_header: Awakened after centuries of stasis. Armed with the discipline of a forgotten age. Trapped on an Earth reborn in fire and crystal.
